key_insight: The paper introduces exact, efficient classical benchmarking methods for fault-tolerant circuits with non-Clifford diagonal gates, enabling fidelity and syndrome analysis without simulating logical measurements.
engineering_relevance: These tools help design and optimize practical magic-state distillation factories and other error-corrected quantum workflows by making high-rate circuit performance tractable to evaluate.
method: Simulate circuits built from X, CNOT, and diagonal gates in the Clifford hierarchy using exact classical algorithms.
Avoid explicit logical-measurement simulation by directly sampling syndrome statistics and estimating output fidelity.
Support state/gate teleportation gadgets with feedforward, and extend to third- and fourth-level diagonal gates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports polynomial scaling in physical qubits n and circuit depth T, and demonstrates the approach by optimizing high-rate magic-state distillation factories based on three copies of a [[27,3,3]] tricycle code.
watch_item: The method is specialized to certain circuit structures and observables, so it may not generalize to arbitrary fault-tolerant architectures or non-diagonal non-Clifford operations.
paper_title: Efficient fidelity simulation of high-rate magic distillation circuits
